portableDeltas.requiredWork: Decode per-session event seq values and replay_epoch, retain source-qualified watermarks, call session.events.since after reconnect, hold racing live frames, reject duplicate/non-increasing events, reset on epoch change, and fail closed to authoritative transcript/history refresh when truncated is true.

Expose compression.checkpoint_required only with checkpoint-capable memory-provider evidence, preserve unknown configuration, surface BLOCKED_MISSING_PREREQUISITE without converting it to a generic disconnect, and cover Hermes, native, micro-compaction, and Codex app-server exclusions.

Replace any static terminal-backend assumption with the gateway's dynamic backend rows and guarded selection API, and represent profile-scoped/shared Docker container identity without inventing a client-local runtime.

Retain the server-driven expanded catalog, then add lossless tools.include/tools.exclude administration that preserves glob exclusions, explicit empty include lists, reinstall filters, and probe-failure state.

Add bounded validated controls for web.cache_enabled, web.cache_ttl_minutes, web.cache_exempt_hosts, and browser.snapshot_threshold; keep cached/truncate-and-store results compatible with the existing generic tool and artifact renderers.

portableNoClientChange: OpenRouter :nitro/:floor model variants are validated by Hermes and remain gateway-catalog driven.

Signal/Telegram/Teams delivery recovery, computer-use MEDIA repair, fallback transitions, MCP/LSP/process recovery, OpenViking identity fixes, and approval outcome objects are server-owned and retain existing Talaria event/tool envelopes.

Browser snapshot truncate-and-store, web-result caching, removed FLUX promo tools, expanded MCP presets, and removed auxiliary.web_extract are server catalog/runtime changes; Talaria must not hard-code the removed surfaces.
Desktop HUD/windowing, keyboard, context-menu, zoom, vibe-heart, embedded-browser-tab, and renderer scrolling changes are true local Desktop behaviors.

pinDecision.reason: The range introduces a material client wire contract and four portable management deltas that are not implemented or certified in Talaria at this audit base.
